paths.path: ~/.config/ppsspp/PSP/SYSTEM/ppsspp.ini and ~/.config/ppsspp/PSP/SYSTEM/controls.ini (memstick root = $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ppsspp when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set, else $HOME/.config/ppsspp; both files are resolved by FindConfigFile against the search path Config::SetSearchPath(GetSysDirectory(DIRECTORY_SYSTEM)) = <memstick>/PSP/SYSTEM)
paths.naming: ppsspp.ini holds [General], [Graphics], [ControlMapping] defaults and per-game recent entries; controls.ini holds input bindings in a single [ControlMapping] section keyed by PSP button names (Up, Down, Left, Right, Circle, Cross, Square, Triangle, Start, Select, L, R, An.Up, An.Down, An.Left, An.Right, RapidFire, Fast-forward, Pause, ...); each value is a comma-separated list of mapped inputs written as "<deviceId>-<keyCode>" (InputMapping::ToConfigString "%d-%d"), with colon-joined multi-mappings; device ids: keyboard = 1, joypads = DEVICE_ID_PAD_0..9 = 10..19 (e.g. "10-1004"); no "InputLst" or "BIND" keys exist anywhere in the pinned tree. Per-game overrides are <GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini next to them in PSP/SYSTEM. Loading a [ControlMapping] section erases absent gameplay defaults (KeyMap::LoadFromIni).
evidence: source:ppsspp/UI/NativeApp.cpp NativeInit: memStickDirectory = Path(getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") or $HOME/.config) / "ppsspp" (commit e49c0bd8836a8a8f678565357773386f1174d3f5)

source:ppsspp/Core/Config.cpp UpdateIniLocation: iniFilename_ = FindConfigFile("ppsspp.ini"), controllerIniFilename_ = FindConfigFile("controls.ini"); FindConfigFile joins searchPath_; Config::getGameConfigFile: <pGameId>_ppsspp.ini
source:ppsspp/Core/Config.cpp SetSearchPath callers: g_Config.SetSearchPath(GetSysDirectory(DIRECTORY_SYSTEM)) in UI/NativeApp.cpp, Windows/main.cpp and Core/Util/MemStick.cpp

paths.path: ~/.config/ppsspp/PSP/SYSTEM/controls.ini (same PSP/SYSTEM root as ppsspp.ini)
paths.naming: Single [ControlMapping] section keyed by PSP button names; values are comma-separated <deviceId>-<keyCode> mappings with colon-joined multi-mappings. Keyboard device id is 1; SDL joypads are 10..19. Per-game overrides are <GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini

paths.path: ~/.config/ppsspp/PSP/SAVEDATA/ (one folder per saved game, PSP ms0:/PSP/SAVEDATA mounted directly at the memstick root)
paths.naming: Directory name = SFO gameName + saveName concatenated, e.g. ULUS10041DATA00, ULUS10041DATA01: SavedataParam::GetSaveDir = GetGameName(param) + saveDirName where gameName is the disc-region id (ULUS/ULES/UCUS... without dash) and saveDirName is the game's per-slot save name (usually DATA00) or a name the player picked from the saveNameList; the .nomedia marker file is created at ms0:/PSP/SAVEDATA/.nomedia; each folder contains PARAM.SFO plus ICON0.PNG/PIC1.PNG and the game's save files; homebrew without DISC_ID gets a generated fake id
evidence: source:ppsspp/Core/Dialog/SavedataParam.cpp GetSaveDirName/GetSaveDir (GetGameName + saveDirName), GetGameName = param->gameName, GetSaveDirName = param->saveName or saveNameList selection; static savePath = "ms0:/PSP/SAVEDATA/"; MkDir(savePath) + ".nomedia" marker
docs:https://www.ppsspp.org/docs/faq/ ("a PSP directory, and within there's SAVEDATA (for real PSP saves) and PPSSPP_STATE (save states)")

paths.path: ~/.config/ppsspp/PSP/PPSSPP_STATE/ (flat directory, no per-game subdirectories in the pinned version; per-game identity lives in the filename prefix)
paths.naming: <DISC_ID>_<DISC_VERSION>_<slot>.ppst, e.g. ULUS10041_1.00_0.ppst: GenerateSaveSlotFilename = "%s_%d.%s" over GenerateFullDiscId (DISC_ID + "_" + DISC_VERSION from the game SFO, fake id generated when absent) and slot 0..4 (SaveState::NUM_SLOTS = 5, current slot kept in [General] CurrentStateSlot of ppsspp.ini); slot screenshots sit alongside as .jpg; a save/load undo layer adds <DISC_ID>_<VER>_<slot>.undo.ppst plus a global load_undo.ppst in the same directory
evidence: source:ppsspp/Core/SaveState.cpp GenerateFullDiscId ("%s_%s", DISC_ID, DISC_VERSION) and GenerateSaveSlotFilename ("%s_%d.%s", GetSysDirectory(DIRECTORY_SAVESTATE))
docs:https://www.ppsspp.org/docs/reference/mac/ (confirms PSP/PPSSPP_STATE alongside PSP/SYSTEM/ppsspp.ini under the ppsspp data root)

paths.path: Optional and not user-installed by default: flash0: is served from the bundled assets (VFS "flash0" on the SDL/Linux build; g_Config.flash0Directory = <exe dir>/assets/flash0). No PSP firmware is required to run games; the emulated firmware version is [SystemPSP] PSPFirmwareVersion in ppsspp.ini (default 660)
paths.naming: assets/flash0 in the pinned tree ships only the replacement font set (assets/flash0/font, loaded via flash0:/font/); a per-user font override can be placed at <memstick>/PSP/flash0/font/. The in-app firmware installer seen in current docs (open the official Sony 6.61 updater EBOOT.PBP in PPSSPP and accept the install, which populates flash0 for the 1.21 VSH support) does not exist in the v1.19.3 pin - no firmware downloader or flash0 writer is present in that tree
evidence: source:ppsspp/Core/HLE/sceIo.cpp __IoInit: flash0System = VFSFileSystem(&pspFileSystem, "flash0") on non-Windows/non-Apple; DirectoryFileSystem(g_Config.flash0Directory) on Windows/Apple

docs:https://www.ppsspp.org/docs/getting-started/how-to-run-the-vsh/ ("you need a PSP update. You can download 6.61 directly from Sony. Next, just open the update in PPSSPP, which will offer to install it for you" - marked for version 1.21, after the pin)

linux.notes: Lunchbox launches the SDL build with HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME deliberately unchanged and Bubblewrap-overlays only PSP/SYSTEM inside the child namespace (crates/lunchbox-app/src/controller_ppsspp/native_command.rs, configuration.rs), so native SAVEDATA/PPSSPP_STATE stay in ~/.config/ppsspp; the launcher re-verifies the resolved search directory XDG_CONFIG_HOME|~/.config + /ppsspp/PSP/SYSTEM before applying a saved setup.

linux-flatpak.notes: The Flathub sandbox grants --filesystem=host:ro (read-only visibility), so the writable memstick root necessarily lands in the app-scoped XDG_CONFIG_HOME; Lunchbox has no containerized launch adapter for PPSSPP yet (controller_ppsspp/native_command.rs requires a native Linux executable).

paths.path: %USERPROFILE%\Documents\PPSSPP\PSP\SYSTEM\ppsspp.ini and PSP\SYSTEM\controls.ini for an installed build; a portable build (no installed.txt next to the exe) uses <exe dir>\memstick\PSP\SYSTEM\ instead; installed.txt containing a path relocates the whole memstick root to that path; if the chosen root is not writable the build falls back to Documents\PPSSPP
paths.naming: Same files and [ControlMapping] syntax as Linux: ppsspp.ini (general settings), controls.ini (bindings as "<deviceId>-<keyCode>" lists, keyboard = 1, pads = 10..19, XInput auto-configured for Xbox pads), <GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini per-game overrides in the same PSP\SYSTEM folder
